source: frozen raw CSV; independently deduplicated by order_item_id and independently recomputed valid line totals; completed orders only
cleaning_semantics: drop duplicate order/order-item IDs keeping first; retain positive qty/unit price, non-null item discount, nonnegative recomputed line total, valid nonnegative order discount and positive source subtotal; allocate order discount in proportion to each line total; static item cost
discount_allocation: net item revenue = recomputed item line total - order discount * item line total / source order subtotal
limitations: Independent source-CSV cleaning may differ on duplicate winner and quality-repair details from canonical Spark v4; compare rows and report actual differences; no label/target or model loaded from Spark.
